summary: Implemented `in` membership for namespace objects. In rdflib/namespace.py, Namespace.__contains__ does a prefix test (str(ref).startswith(str(self))), and ClosedNamespace.__contains__ returns True only when str(ref) equals the str() of a stored term URI; _RDFNamespace inherits it. In test/test_namespace.py, I added NamespaceContainsTest covering Namespace prefix positive/negative cases, SH membership, RDFS positive/negative cases, and RDF rdf:type (True) and rdf:_1 (False). Nothing was committed. Tests and doctests were not run, per the instructions, so the changes are verified by reading only.
